# TFD Weapons – The Supreme Art of War

> All 43 Ultimate and 11 Transcendent weapons of The First Descendant with Feature, Unique Ability (max level values) and Level 100 stats – official NEXON data.

Page: https://weapons.freyna.org/
Sources: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons?tier=Tier3 , https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons?tier=Tier4 , https://open.api.nexon.com/static/tfd/meta/en/weapon.json
Notation [x]/[+] exactly as in the official data. Ultimate Unique Ability values at Unique Ability Level 4 (max).

## Afterglow Sword
- Type: Sniper Rifle | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: High-Power Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211093001
- Feature: It was made to commemorate Neil Neldor, the legendary sniper nicknamed the Nightmare Reaper. A specialized sniper rifle that uses particularly lethal bullets.
- Unique Ability: Nightmare Reaper (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - Aiming at a target engages Lock-On.
  - Lock-On automatically aims at the target's Weak Point.
  - Attacking an enemy's Weak Point in Lock-On grants increased Firearm ATK and Weak Point Damage.
- Lock-On: Aim Time 0.5s; Firearm ATK 458%[x]; Weak Point Damage 300%[+]
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 114,206; Fire Rate 66; Weak Point Damage 2.76; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 5,500; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 8,500; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.6; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 44.444; Aimed Shot Accuracy 100; Rounds per Magazine 12; Reload Time 2.5; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 500; Movement Speed While Firing 320; Movement Speed While Aiming 230; Crush 10; Penetration 100; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 50; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 2; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 33.33; Multi-Hit Damage 0.1

## Albion Cavalry Gun
- Type: Machine Gun | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: General Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211053002
- Feature: An enhanced version of the machine gun once used by the Albion Special Cavalry. It has been modified to improve mobility.
- Unique Ability: Cavalry (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - On hit, inflicts Mark on the enemy. On hitting an enemy inflicted with Mark, increases Critical Hit Rate and deals Additional Damage.
  - Each Critical Hit Ricochets to the nearby enemy with the highest remaining HP and Stuns the enemies hit by the Ricochet.
  - If a Ricochet lands a Critical Hit, creates an additional Ricochet.
  - Inflicts Frosty on enemies that received Additional Damage through Mark or Ricochet.
  - Continued fire grants Horseshoe to self.
- On hitting an enemy inflicted with Mark: Firearm Critical Hit Rate 33.0[+]; Additional Damage Firearm Damage x 200%
- Ricochet: Applied Target 4; Damage Firearm Damage x 423%; Max Bounces 2 times
- Stun: Duration 4.0s
- Frosty: Chill Resistance -10%[x]
- Horseshoe: Firing Duration Every 0.1s; Max Stacks 10; Movement Speed When Not Aiming 50[+]; Movement Speed per Stack while Firing 50[+]; Movement Speed While Aiming 50[+]; Movement Speed per Stack while Aiming 50[+]
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 13,469; Chill ATK 8,217; Fire Rate 451; Weak Point Damage 1; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 4,500; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 7,500; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.6; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 72.222; Aimed Shot Accuracy 77.777; Rounds per Magazine 75; Reload Time 2.5; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 400; Movement Speed While Firing 220; Movement Speed While Aiming 130; Crush 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 7; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 2; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 5.88; Multi-Hit Damage 0.45

## Ancient Knight
- Type: Assault Rifle | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: General Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211063004
- Feature: An assault rifle used by the early Descendants during the onset of the Apocalypse,
created by modifying holy relics guarded by the Knights of Humanity into the form of a firearm.
- Unique Ability: Descending Judgment (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - When reloading in midair, grants Float.
  - When multi-hit triggers in midair, grants Atonement.
  - Float and Atonement are removed when touching the ground.
- Float: Effective Range (Drop-off start) 130%[x]; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 130%[x]; HP Recovery Chance on Hit 10%; Health Recovery Amount 2.0%
- Atonement: Max Stacks 10; Multi-Hit Damage 7.7[+]; Multi-Hit Damage per Stack 7.7[+]
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 16,318; Fire ATK 5,875; Fire Rate 521; Weak Point Damage 1; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 3,300; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 5,800; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.4; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 88.888; Aimed Shot Accuracy 91.111; Rounds per Magazine 27; Reload Time 1.8; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 525; Movement Speed While Firing 345; Movement Speed While Aiming 255; Pierce 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 3; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.2; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 4.35; Multi-Hit Damage 0.54

## A-TAMS
- Type: Sniper Rifle | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: High-Power Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211093003
- Feature: A powerful anti-materiel sniper rifle that condenses the user's Arche to accelerate bullets.
- Unique Ability: Electronic Arche Infusion (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - When aiming, continuously consumes MP to infuse Arche and fill the gauge.
  - When firing, deals increased damage based on the charge of the gauge.
- Basic Information: MP Cost 0.5 MP per 0.1s; Max Gauge 100%; Gauge Increase 5.0% per 0.1s; Additional Max Damage Firearm Damage x 260%
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 228,622; Fire Rate 52; Weak Point Damage 1.65; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 5,500; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 8,500; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.6; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 27.777; Aimed Shot Accuracy 100; Rounds per Magazine 3; Reload Time 2; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 400; Movement Speed While Firing 220; Movement Speed While Aiming 130; Crush 10; Penetration 100; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 50; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.5; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 33.33; Multi-Hit Damage 0.1

## Blue Beetle
- Type: Scout Rifle | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: Impact Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211083002
- Feature: The Arche Reactor was developed for applying the newest technologies and is proof of Albion's technological prowess. It is loaded with a special device that aids in battle through Arche Efflux.
- Unique Ability: Arcane Wave (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - When using a Fusion skill, grants self the unique effect Arcane Energy with a set chance. When using a Singular skill, grants self the unique effect Purification with a set chance.
- Arcane Energy: Trigger Rate 100%; Duration 10s; Skill Critical Hit Rate 115%[x]
- Purification: Trigger Rate 100%; Duration 1s; Remove Debuff 100%
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 29,468; Electric ATK 26,816; Fire Rate 200; Weak Point Damage 3.93; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 3,500; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 6,500; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.6; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 72.222; Aimed Shot Accuracy 100; Rounds per Magazine 16; Reload Time 2; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 520; Movement Speed While Firing 340; Movement Speed While Aiming 250; Crush 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 25; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.8; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 12.5; Multi-Hit Damage 0.1

## Clairvoyance
- Type: Beam Rifle | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: Special Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211123002
- Feature: A special weapon crafted with the Colossus Stunning Beauty's components and the Eye of Judgement. The beam it emits when fired applies many additional effects.
- Unique Ability: The Thing Beyond (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - Hitting an enemy with a Stage 3 Beam inflicts Void Gaze on the enemy.
  - At max stacks of Void Gaze, inflicts additional Appalled Calling and Chasm.
  - Appalled Calling is considered the same as Frostbite in some mechanics.
  - Hitting a target inflicted with Chasm using a Stage 3 Beam stacks Frozen Spear.
  - At max stacks of Frozen Spear, the next firearm shot fires a Frozen Spear.
  - Frozen Spear deals additional damage to targets inflicted with Chasm.
  - Frozen Spear damage does not trigger Critical Hits, but triggers Multi-Hits.
- Void Gaze: Duration 5s; Max Stacks 5
- Appalled Calling: Duration 10s; Action Speed -10%[+]
- Chasm: Duration 10s; Chill Resistance -40%[x]
- Frozen Spear: Max Stacks 5; Damage per Projectile Firearm Damage x 130%; Additional Damage Projectile Damage x 150%
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 13,362; Chill ATK 13,362; Fire Rate 400; Weak Point Damage 1.45; ATK Drop-off Modifier 1; Max Range 3,500; Hip Fire Accuracy 98.888; Aimed Shot Accuracy 100; Rounds per Magazine 40; Reload Time 2.2; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 600; Movement Speed While Firing 420; Movement Speed While Aiming 330; Pierce 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 20; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 2; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 6.67; Multi-Hit Damage 0.51

## Crime and Punishment
- Type: Balanced Melee Weapon | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: Impact Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/221133004
- Feature: A melee weapon featuring two lightweight straight swords. It is capable of harnessing the rotational kinetic energy of the blades to either amplify power or unleash a rapid barrage of deadly strikes.
- Unique Ability: Final Verdict (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - On hitting an enemy, Judgment Gauge increases. When Judgment Gauge increases, Condemnation Stage also increases. When the Special Attack button is pressed, the caster uses Final Verdict to spin forward and deal damage to enemies within range. When Final Verdict hits, an additional attack occurs, and damage increases proportionally to Condemnation Stage. When Final Verdict hits, Execution is gained in proportion to Condemnation Stage. While Execution is active, Normal Attacks consume Execution to deal additional damage.
- Final Verdict: Damage Melee Weapon Damage x 105.0%; Damage Increase per Condemnation Stage 75.0%; Condemnation Stage Cost Stage 2
- Condemnation Stage: Min Stage Stage E; Max Stage Stage S; Time to Trigger 10s
- Execution: Damage Melee Weapon Damage x 12.5%; Max Owned 100; Amount Acquired 10; Additional Gain for Condemnation Stage 2
- Special Attack Gauge: Consumed when Used -100.0
- Stat Info (Level 100): Melee Weapon ATK 233,336; Melee Weapon Fire ATK 158,436; Attack Speed 0.459; Melee Weapon Critical Hit Rate 5; Melee Weapon Critical Hit Damage 1; Additional Attack Damage 1.2; Melee Weapon Piercing Rate 0.06; Melee Weapon Min. Piercing Rate 0.4; Burst 10; Max Melee Weapon Attack Range Multiplier 2; Movement Speed 610; Sprint Speed 1,040; Max Block Gauge 200; Start Block Gauge Cost 10; Maintain Block Gauge Cost 1.7; Block Gauge Recovery Start Time 3; Block Gauge Recovery Amount 40; Block Efficiency 0.3; Max Special Attack Gauge 100; Special Attack Gauge Recovery Start Time 0; Special Attack Gauge Recovery Amount 50; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 20

## Deus Ex Manus
- Type: Power Melee Weapon | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: High-Power Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/221133002
- Feature: A melee weapon with a built-in Vibration Energy Collector that can store intense kinetic energy. When attacking, it can release all the stored vibration energy in a single burst.
- Unique Ability: Liberation (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - On successful Normal attack, grants the unique effects Liberation and Resistance to self. Pressing the Special Attack button while Liberation is active removes Liberation, and strikes down forward with the weapon to damage to all enemies within range. Increases Damage as the number of Liberation stacks increase.
- Basic Information: Damage Melee Weapon Damage x 256.0%
- Liberation: Duration No limit; Max Stacks 4; Damage per Stack Melee Weapon Damage x 80.0%
- Resistance: Duration 3s; Decreases Incoming DMG -10.5%[+]
- Stat Info (Level 100): Melee Weapon ATK 523,934; Melee Weapon Chill ATK 157,180; Attack Speed 0.68; Melee Weapon Critical Hit Rate 50; Melee Weapon Critical Hit Damage 2; Additional Attack Damage 0.1; Melee Weapon Piercing Rate 0.02; Melee Weapon Min. Piercing Rate 0.7; Crush 10; Max Melee Weapon Attack Range Multiplier 2; Movement Speed 580; Sprint Speed 1,040; Max Block Gauge 300; Start Block Gauge Cost 10; Maintain Block Gauge Cost 2.2; Block Gauge Recovery Start Time 2.75; Block Gauge Recovery Amount 40; Block Efficiency 0.5; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 25

## Divine Punishment
- Type: Assault Rifle | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: General Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211063002
- Feature: A firearm the Magisters reverse engineered from a weapon they procured from the Order of Truth. Its Arcane power, not yet fully understood even by the Magisters, can help tremendously in battle.
- Unique Ability: Prayer (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - When using a Healing or Charging type skill, grants Praise to self.
  - While Praise is active, landing a Multi-Hit has a chance to trigger Purifying Blaze on the target to deal damage.
  - When triggered, Purifying Blaze triggers Multi-Hit.
  - The damage dealt by Purifying Blaze increases based on the number of Praise stacks.
  - When triggered, Purifying Blaze grants Warmth to self and nearby allies.
- Purifying Blaze: Trigger Condition 3 times; Damage Firearm Damage x 620%; Additional Damage per Praise Stack Firearm Damage x 500%
- Praise: Duration 15s; Max Stacks 4; Skill Cooldown -6.0%[+]; Skill Cooldown per Stack -6.0%[+]
- Warmth: Effect Apply Range Radius 20m; Duration 15s; All Attribute Resistance 30.0%[x]; Incoming Damage Modifier -10.0%[+]; HP Recovery Modifier 0.10[+]; Shield Recovery Modifier 0.10[+]
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 10,624; Fire ATK 9,031; Fire Rate 705; Weak Point Damage 1.56; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 3,000; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 5,500; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.4; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 80; Aimed Shot Accuracy 88.888; Rounds per Magazine 35; Reload Time 1.55; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 580; Movement Speed While Firing 400; Movement Speed While Aiming 310; Pierce 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 10; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.7; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 3.85; Multi-Hit Damage 0.9

## E-Buster
- Type: Submachine Gun | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: General Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211043003
- Feature: A firearm designed to harness the increase in entropy caused by kinetic energy as usable energy. However, as that chaos cannot yet be fully understood, it is limited by highly inefficient energy conversion.
- Unique Ability: Entropy Overlap (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - When using an Electric skill, grants Entropy Overlap to self.
  - While Entropy Overlap is active, using a Tracking Projectile type skill grants Entropy Conversion to self and grants Entropy Energy Round.
  - While Entropy Energy Rounds are available, firing a firearm consumes Entropy Energy Rounds to deal additional damage.
  - Entropy Energy Rounds cause Multi-Hits on hit.
- Entropy Overlap: Duration 15s
- Entropy Conversion: Electric Skill Power Boost Ratio 17%[+]; Electric Skill Power Boost Ratio per Stack 16%[+]; Duration 15s; Max Stacks 5
- Entropy Energy Round: Damage Firearm Damage x 880%; Bullets Acquired 50; Max Ammo Capacity 200
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 18,999; Fire Rate 769; Weak Point Damage 1; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 2,300; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 4,300; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.3; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 66.666; Aimed Shot Accuracy 74.444; Rounds per Magazine 33; Reload Time 1.32; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 600; Movement Speed While Firing 600; Movement Speed While Aiming 600; Burst 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 5; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 3.33; Multi-Hit Damage 0.6

## Enduring Legacy
- Type: Machine Gun | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: General Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211053001
- Feature: A firearm that was reverse engineered from a weapon seized by Vulgus during the apocalypse. After many improvements, it can counter many different attributes. It is particularly effective when used for the Fire Arche ability.
- Unique Ability: Craftsmanship (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - Maintaining fire of a firearm grants Quenching at regular intervals.
  - At max stacks of Quenching, grants Incendiary Shot to self.
  - While Incendiary Shot is active, an Explosive Bullet is fired after a certain number of shots.
  - Explosive Bullets inflict Flame Wound on the hit target.
  - While Incendiary Shot is active, deals additional damage to targets inflicted with Flame Wound.
  - Additional damage is not affected by Critical Hit or Multi-Hit.
- Quenching: Time to Trigger 0.25s; Duration 10s; Max Stacks 10; Fire Rate -16.5%[x]; Firearm ATK 130%[x]
- Incendiary Shot: Fire ATK 500%[x]; Explosive Bullet Firing Interval x5 Shots; Flame Wound Additional Damage 60%
- Explosive Bullet: Range Radius 2.0m; Damage Firearm Damage x 525%
- Flame Wound: Duration 15s; Fire Resistance -20%[x]
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 13,155; Fire ATK 6,578; Fire Rate 571; Weak Point Damage 1.85; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 4,000; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 7,000; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.55; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 61.111; Aimed Shot Accuracy 66.666; Rounds per Magazine 115; Reload Time 2.7; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 450; Movement Speed While Firing 270; Movement Speed While Aiming 180; Crush 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 20; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 2.3; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 4.76; Multi-Hit Damage 0.1

## ERASER
- Type: Scout Rifle | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: Impact Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211083005
- Feature: A firearm developed by the Red Arms Medical Corps that can discharge special enzymes to remove organic matter from the battlefield.
- Unique Ability: Erase (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - On hitting an enemy, grants Analyze.
  - Analyze converts to Degrade at max stacks.
  - While Degrade is active, firing creates Degrading Enzymes at the hit location.
  - Enemies hit by Degrading Enzymes are inflicted with Corrosion and suffer weakened Adaptive Defense.
- Analyze: Acquired on Enemy Hit 5; Max Stacks 10
- Degrading Enzyme: Max Number of Creations x50; Range Radius 15m; Duration 5.0s; Continuous Damage Interval 0.25s; Damage Firearm Damage x 350%
- Corrosion: Duration 5s; Toxic Weapon Resistance -20%[x]
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 29,303; Toxic ATK 16,117; Fire Rate 240; Weak Point Damage 3.55; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 4,200; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 7,200; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.6; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 83.333; Aimed Shot Accuracy 92.222; Rounds per Magazine 18; Reload Time 2.2; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 530; Movement Speed While Firing 350; Movement Speed While Aiming 260; Crush 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 18; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.3; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 8.33; Multi-Hit Damage 0.34

## EXCAVA
- Type: Assault Rifle | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: General Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211063003
- Feature: A powerful composite rifle that gathers power generated by an electronic firing mechanism to fire voltage-accelerated energy grenades.
- Unique Ability: Voltage Accel Energy Grenade Launcher (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - Hitting an enemy grants the unique effect Voltage Charge. When Voltage Charge reaches max stacks, it changes to the unique effect Energy Grenade. While Energy Grenade is active, fires an Energy Grenade when shooting while aiming, which deals increased damage based on the number of stacks. Hitting an enemy with the Energy Grenade inflicts Voltage Accumulation.
- Voltage Charge: Duration 5.0s; Max Stacks 15
- Energy Grenade: Duration No limit; Max Stacks 3; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 5[+]; Firearm Critical Hit Rate per Stack 5[+]
- While aiming: Additional Damage Firearm DMG x Number of Stacks x 220%; Ammo Cost per shot -4
- Voltage Accumulation: Duration 5s; Max Stacks 3; Electric Resistance -3.0%[x]; Electric Resistance per Stack -4%[x]
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 14,937; Electric ATK 12,249; Fire Rate 588; Weak Point Damage 1.4; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 3,000; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 5,500; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.4; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 86.666; Aimed Shot Accuracy 90; Rounds per Magazine 36; Reload Time 2; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 525; Movement Speed While Firing 345; Movement Speed While Aiming 255; Pierce 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 3; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.2; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 4.35; Multi-Hit Damage 0.38

## Executor
- Type: Shotgun | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: High-Power Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211033002
- Feature: A weapon created after researching the weapons and components of the intercepted Colossus Executioner. The higher the user's Hit Rate, the better this weapon will perform.
- Unique Ability: Impending Judgement (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - On hitting the enemy with all bullets, grants the unique ability Executor's Exaltation.
  - At the highest stage, increases Weak Point Damage on hit and inflicts Electrocution on the target enemy.
- Executor's Exaltation: Duration 5s; Max Stacks 3; Accuracy 10%[x]; Accuracy per Stack 5%[x]; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 33[+]; Firearm Critical Hit Rate per Stack 33[+]; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 30[+]; Firearm Critical Hit DMG per Stack 30[+]; Fire Rate -0.05s[+]; Fire Rate per Stack -0.05s[+]; Weak Point Damage at Max Stacks 20%[x]

## Exterminator
- Type: Launcher | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: High-Power Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211103005
- Feature: A multiple Rocket Launcher with special Explosive Rounds that can penetrate heavy armor. Its built-in, optimal auto-aiming system scans and targets heavily armored enemies, then fires rockets.
- Unique Ability: Exterminate! (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - When holding aim, automatically designates targets on the screen.
  - When firing, fires Explosive Rounds at the targeted enemies.
  - Explosive Rounds trigger Multi-Hits.
  - Explosive Rounds deal Additional Damage to special units such as the Razor Claw's Carapace Hull and the Steel Pincer's Armored Carapace, and have a more powerful effect on Cluster Sacs, Cluster Tunnels, and Assault Ships.
- Basic Information: Number of Targets 6; Targeting Time 0.01s; Range Radius 5m
- Explosive Rounds: Damage Firearm Damage x 75.5%
- Razor Claw's Carapace Hull, Steel Pincer's Armored Carapace: Additional Damage Firearm Damage x 65.7%
- Cluster Sac, Cluster Tunnel, and Assault Ship: Additional Damage Firearm Damage x 1051.2%
- Stat Info (Level 100): Explosive ATK 168,776; Fire ATK 138,397; Fire Rate 50; Explosion ATK Drop-off Range 0.45; Weak Point Damage 1; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 98.888; Aimed Shot Accuracy 100; Rounds per Magazine 12; Reload Time 3.2; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 450; Movement Speed While Firing 270; Movement Speed While Aiming 180; Pierce 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 10; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.15; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 33.33; Launcher Explosion Radius 500; Multi-Hit Damage 0.19

## Eye of the Typhoon
- Type: Beam Rifle | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: Special Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211123005
- Feature: This new weapon, equipped with a small, circular engine called the Typhoon, utilizes a special coil to generate its own electromagnetic force. The generated electromagnetic force gradually accumulates within the Typhoon engine, ready to be released when needed.
- Unique Ability: Typhoon (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - Press the aim button to switch between Typhoon Mode and Storm Mode. Storm Mode can only be activated when there is at least 1 Typhoon Energy.
  - Typhoon Mode
  - Automatically targets enemies on screen.
  - When firing, launches attacks at each targeted enemy.
  - Hitting an enemy accumulates Typhoon Energy.
  - Storm Mode
  - Fires a high-damage attack in the aimed direction.
  - Storm Mode consumes Typhoon Energy instead of Rounds.
- Basic Information: Max Typhoon Energy Capacity 150
- Typhoon Mode: Applied Target 8; Typhoon Energy Acquired 2 per 1 hits
- Storm Mode: Typhoon Energy Consumed 1; Additional Damage Firearm Damage x 303.0%
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 13,364; Electric ATK 6,919; Fire Rate 375; Weak Point Damage 1; ATK Drop-off Modifier 1; Max Range 3,200; Hip Fire Accuracy 98.888; Aimed Shot Accuracy 100; Rounds per Magazine 38; Reload Time 2.05; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 530; Movement Speed While Firing 350; Movement Speed While Aiming 260; Pierce 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 35; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.72; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 5; Multi-Hit Damage 0.11

## Fallen Hope
- Type: Assault Rifle | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: General Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211063001
- Feature: A firearm with a poison effect so potent it can crush all the enemy's remaining hope. Fortunately, it does not affect the wielder.
- Unique Ability: Perdition (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - Using a Toxic skill grants Toxin Aggregation to self.
  - While Toxin Aggregation is active, using a Ground DoT type skill grants Toxin Discharge to self.
  - While Toxin Discharge is active, hitting an enemy has a chance to activate Perdition on the target, dealing additional damage and inflicting Poison on enemies within range.
  - While Toxin Discharge is active, defeating an enemy has a chance to cause them to Explode, to deal additional damage and inflict Poison on nearby enemies.
  - The additional damage of Perdition increases proportionally to the combined stacks of Poison and Toxin Discharge inflicted on the target.
- Basic Information: Hip Fire Accuracy -20%[x]; Aimed Shot Accuracy -20%[x]
- Toxin Aggregation: Duration 15.0s; Firearm ATK 65%[x]; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 20%[+]
- Toxin Discharge: Duration 15.0s; Max Stacks 5; Toxic Skill Power Boost Ratio 19%[+]; Toxic Skill Power Boost Ratio per Stack 19%[+]
- Perdition: Trigger Rate 40%; Damage Range Radius 4.0m; Damage Firearm Damage x 390%; Damage Increase per Poison Stack Firearm Damage x 140%; Max Poison Stacks 4; Damage Increase per Toxin Discharge Stack Firearm Damage x 70%
- Explosion: Trigger Rate 50%; Damage Range Radius 4.0m; Damage Firearm Damage x 80%
- Poison: Duration 5s; Damage Interval 0.5s; Additional Damage Firearm Damage x 15%
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 12,813; Toxic ATK 12,429; Fire Rate 600; Weak Point Damage 1.2; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 3,500; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 6,000; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.4; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 83.333; Aimed Shot Accuracy 88.888; Rounds per Magazine 35; Reload Time 1.7; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 550; Movement Speed While Firing 370; Movement Speed While Aiming 280; Pierce 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 12; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.7; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 4.55; Multi-Hit Damage 1

## Frenzied Locomotive
- Type: Machine Gun | Tier: Ultimate | Rounds: General Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211053003
- Feature: A machine gun that achieves an increased rate of fire by heating its specially coated barrel. It was given a somewhat aggressive name because it relentlessly fires bullets until it reaches a critical temperature that triggers its safety mechanism.
- Unique Ability: Sprint Instinct (Unique Ability Level 4 (max))
  - Firing applies Preheating. Shots are fired once Preheating is completed.

  - Fires a Sticky Bomb when shooting while aiming.
  - The launched bomb will automatically detonate after a certain period of time after sticking to an enemy. When aim is cancelled, all attached bombs will detonate at the same time, regardless of whether the countdown has been completed.
  - The damage of Sticky Bombs increases proportionally to the number of Sticky Bombs attached.
  - The damage of Sticky Bombs decreases as the number of targets hit by the Sticky Bomb detonations increases.
  - Upon detonation, Sticky Bombs inflict Thermal Burn on damaged enemies.
- Sticky Bomb: Detonation Time 7s; Damage Increase per Bomb 45.0%; Max Stacks x8; Damage Reduction per target 20.0%; Min Damage 20.0%; Max Number of Creations x8
- Thermal Burn: Duration 3s; Damage Interval 1s; Max Stacks 8; Additional Damage Firearm Damage x 10.0%; Additional DMG per Stack Firearm Damage x 13.0%
- Stat Info (Level 100): Explosive ATK 87,476; Toxic ATK 27,993; Fire Rate 80; Explosion ATK Drop-off Range 0.3; Weak Point Damage 1; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 98.888; Aimed Shot Accuracy 100; Rounds per Magazine 10; Reload Time 2.8; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 450; Movement Speed While Firing 270; Movement Speed While Aiming 180; Pierce 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 35; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.5; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 25; Launcher Explosion Radius 510; Multi-Hit Damage 0.1

  - When Turbulence hits a Wind Snare at max stacks, forms a Gust and deals damage to targets within range.
  - If an additional Wind Snare is created beyond max stacks, removes the Wind Snare with the shortest remaining duration and triggers Down Burst that deals damage to targets within range.

- Updraft: Duration 5s; Jump Increase 100%[x]
- Air Resistance: Duration 1s; Movement Speed -30%[x]

## Unleashed Instinct
- Type: Shotgun | Tier: Transcendent | Rounds: High-Power Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211034001
- Feature: A firearm designed to reverse the function of Gley's Ultimate Equipment, causing energy to be released from within the enemy's body. In particular, it incorporates a unique technology that induces the release of blood from the enemy's body and then tracks or detonates it.
- Unique Ability: Bloody Hunt (Unique Ability (no level values in the official library))
  - As the Reload Time Modifier increases, increases Load Capacity.Dealing Damage has a chance to inflict Excessive Bleeding on the enemy per Shotgun shot.When defeating or damaging an enemy inflicted with Excessive Bleeding or Bleed, deals Explosion Damage around that enemy.Inflicting Excessive Bleeding grants Hunting Instinct to self.Hunting Instinct increases Movement Speed and deals Additional Damage when attacking with a Shotgun.When an enemy inflicted with Excessive Bleeding is nearby, refreshes the duration of Hunting Instinct.
- Sub Ability: Attribute Conversion: Fire
- Note: Stats from the Nexon Open API metadata (the official library page shows no stat block for Transcendent weapons; values as rounded by the API).
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 35,233; Fire ATK 63,420; Fire Rate 100; Shell Capacity 9; Weak Point Damage 1; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 1,000; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 2,300; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.15; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 13.33; Aimed Shot Accuracy 46.66; Rounds per Magazine 8; Reload Time 1.4; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 550; Movement Speed While Firing 370; Movement Speed While Aiming 280; Burst 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 2; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.1; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 9.2; Multi-Hit Damage 0.25

## Volcanic Heart
- Type: Scout Rifle | Tier: Transcendent | Rounds: Impact Rounds
- Official page: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/weapons/211084001
- Feature: A firearm created by fabricating and implanting a micro-core that mimics the mechanisms of the Colossi Infernal Walker and Molten Fortress. To control the heat, technology used in Transcendent Weapons was integrated into its energy circulation system to prevent the barrel from melting.
- Unique Ability: Pulsating Ember (Unique Ability (no level values in the official library))
  - Increases Fire Skill Power Amplification Rate while holding a weapon.Fire Skill hits on an enemy inflict Pulsating Ember, and firearm hits on an enemy inflicted with Pulsating Ember deal Additional Damage to the target.When defeating an enemy with a Fire Skill or firearm, there is a chance to grant Magma to self that deals Fire Damage to nearby enemies.Additional Damage dealt by this Transcendent Effect does not affect other skill effects.
- Sub Ability: Attribute Conversion: Fire; Barrel Wear
- Note: Stats from the Nexon Open API metadata (the official library page shows no stat block for Transcendent weapons; values as rounded by the API).
- Stat Info (Level 100): Firearm ATK 24,974; Fire ATK 54,943; Fire Rate 166; Weak Point Damage 1.85; Effective Range (Drop-off start) 4,000; Effective Range (Drop-off end) 7,000; ATK Drop-off Modifier 0.6; Max Range 15,000; Hip Fire Accuracy 83.33; Aimed Shot Accuracy 92.22; Rounds per Magazine 30; Reload Time 2.7; Sprint Speed 800; Movement Speed 550; Movement Speed While Firing 370; Movement Speed While Aiming 280; Crush 10; Firearm Critical Hit Rate 50; Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.55; Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate 12.5; Multi-Hit Damage 0.065
